rationale: The request describes workflow-level obstruction spanning timeout recovery, duplicate creation, cross-channel approval, and unclear ownership, so the skill applies. The no-modification boundary and request for a better flow select Redesign. The response defines a coherent replacement sequence, lifecycle, ownership model, source of truth, recovery behavior, and verification plan without writing to the fixture. Read-only inspection confirmed only the blocked fixture state, which the response correctly separated from requester-provided workflow details, inferred design choices, and unresolved decisions. It did not expose Redesign as a mode heading, did not claim the proposed behavior was validated, and stayed proportionate to the affected workflow.
